prompt: Implement a scheduled task that escalates overdue policy reviews. Notify managers. Create audit trail.
spec_yaml:
task_id: scheduled-policy-review-escalation
summary: "Implement a scheduled task to escalate overdue policy reviews, notify managers, and create an audit trail"
depends_on: ["stage-1-core-models", "stage-2-notifications"]
local_goals:
  - id: L1
    description: "INSPECT: check existing policy review model and routes before adding endpoints"
    verification:
      type: file_exists
      path: "src/models/PolicyReview.ts"
      expect:
        exists: true
  - id: L2
    description: "CREATE: add scheduled task to escalate overdue policy reviews"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L3
    description: "CREATE: add notification logic for managers when a review is escalated"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/notifications"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L4
    description: "CREATE: create an audit trail for policy review escalations"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L5
    description: "VERIFY: Scheduled task correctly identifies overdue reviews and sends notifications"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: GET
      url: http://localhost:3000/api/escalate-reviews
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {{test_token}}"
      expect:
        status: 200
        json_schema:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              reviewId: { type: string }
              managerEmail: { type: string }
            required: [reviewId, managerEmail]
  - id: L6
    description: "VERIFY: Audit trail is created for each escalated policy review"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm test --filter=@verified-attention/api -- --testPathPattern=audit-trail"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
global_goals_refs: ["G5", "G13"]
context:
  language: TypeScript
  framework: Express
  orm: Prisma
  test_framework: Vitest
validation_errors: Goals L2 and L4: near-duplicate verification (type=cli, same target). Each goal should verify a distinct aspect.

spec_yaml:
context:
  framework: Express
  language: TypeScript
  orm: Prisma
  test_framework: Vitest
depends_on:
- stage-1-core-models
- stage-2-pipeline
global_goals_refs:
- G5
- G13
local_goals:
- description: 'INSPECT: check existing session model and routes before adding endpoints'
  id: L1
  verification:
    expect:
      exists: true
    path: src/models/Session.ts
    type: file_exists
- description: 'INSPECT: check existing API routes structure'
  id: L2
  verification:
    command: cat apps/api/src/routes/sessions.ts
    expect:
      exit_code: 0
    type: cli
- description: 'CREATE: add POST /v1/sessions endpoint and session model extensions'
  id: L3
  verification:
    command: pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api
    expect:
      exit_code: 0
    type: cli
- description: 'CREATE: add GET/PATCH/POST endpoints for session lifecycle'
  id: L4
  verification:
    command: pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api
    expect:
      exit_code: 0
    type: cli
- description: 'VERIFY: POST /v1/sessions creates a session and returns sessionId'
  id: L5
  verification:
    body:
      contentId: test-content
    expect:
      json_schema:
        properties:
          sessionId:
            type: string
        required:
        - sessionId
        type: object
      status: 201
    headers:
      Authorization: Bearer {{test_token}}
    method: POST
    type: http
    url: http://localhost:3000/v1/sessions
- description: 'VERIFY: GET /v1/sessions/:id returns the session with evidence and
    claims'
  id: L6
  verification:
    expect:
      json_schema:
        properties:
          claims:
            type: array
          evidence:
            type: array
          sessionId:
            type: string
          state:
            type: string
        required:
        - sessionId
        - state
        type: object
      status: 200
    headers:
      Authorization: Bearer {{test_token}}
    method: GET
    type: http
    url: http://localhost:3000/v1/sessions/{session_id}
- description: 'VERIFY: Session state machine rejects invalid transitions'
  id: L7
  verification:
    command: pnpm test --filter=@verified-attention/api -- --testPathPattern=session-state-machine
    expect:
      exit_code: 0
    type: cli
- description: 'VERIFY: OpenAPI spec is valid and contains session endpoints'
  id: L8
  verification:
    command: npx @redocly/cli lint apps/api/openapi.yaml && grep '/v1/sessions' apps/api/openapi.yaml
    expect:
      exit_code: 0
    type: cli
summary: REST API for session lifecycle with state machine enforcement and evidence
  integration
task_id: session-lifecycle-api
